limitations: The NotOwner error in set_name/clear_name is redundant: the PDA seeds already bind user_data to the signer, so a different wallet hits ConstraintSeeds first.
The unused NameGen.tsx component still passes setName a string; the hosted page (app/page.tsx) encodes [u8; 64] via toFixedU8_64 and reads the name from the 8+32+64 account layout.
